changes.comment: The peer dependency on `@react-typed-forms/core` moves from `^4.6.0` to `^5.0.0`. v5 folds the `@astroapps/controls` engine in and is ESM-only, and a consuming app must mount `<ControlContextProvider value={getCompatContext()}>` above its tree — v5 has no implicit control context and no no-provider fallback
